name: Cat Skull Repulsion (Combat)
body:
Knocking an unwary foe off-balance is as easy as tipping a sleeping paramylodon.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, BAB +3, Cat Skull Combat, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: When using this style, you may gain a +2 bonus to AC against flatfooted creatures you hit with your unarmed strike until the end of your next turn. You may also give this benefit to an adjacent ally.

Special: This style’s benefit applies to light weapons, natural weapons, and one-handed weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
